assay_hash_policy: Metadata and feature-schema hashes are frozen now. An assay file is hashed only after a public stage claim: source-stage hashing for source-selected RNA and ADT files, held RNA-stage hashing for target RNA files, and held ADT-stage hashing for target ADT files.
designation_basis: Official GEO MINiML, file manifest, processed-cell metadata, gene feature lists, and antibody feature references only; no RNA or ADT matrix row or numeric assay value was opened.

insufficient_single_pool_cells.reason: fewer than 384 cells in every single pool
fewer than 384 cells in every single pool

nonpaired_geo_samples.rule: exclude every GEO sample without paired processed RNA and ADT CITE-seq matrices

rna_only_donor.reason: scRNA-seq sample has no paired ADT assay

held_acquisition_cluster_rule: Run-date prefix of the selected pool. Different GSM lanes from the same run date form one acquisition cluster for blocked inference.
marker_rule: The 16 ordered cognates occur in every public RNA gene feature list and match an invariant antibody oligo sequence in every public CITE-seq feature reference; aliases exhaust the observed id/name forms after exact alphanumeric canonicalization.

selected_pool_rule: For each donor, use only the single CITE-seq pool with the largest publisher-filtered metadata cell count; break an exact count tie by lexicographically smallest GSM accession. Never aggregate cells across pools.

source_split.rule: The eight selected-pool components are disjoint across calibration and validation. Donors sharing one selected pool remain in the same component and role.

support_contract.adt_axis_validity: within-donor processed ADT values must contain at least two distinct values and the largest equal-value fraction must be at most 0.90
support_contract.attrition_rule: every source and held donor must retain at least 9 valid RNA axes, 9 valid ADT axes, and 128 valid ordered pairs before prediction or scoring; otherwise the stage terminates without donor replacement or threshold revision
support_contract.estimand: the donor-supported RNA-by-ADT submap; loss is averaged over each donor's informative ordered pairs without donor attrition
support_contract.ordered_pair_validity: an ordered RNA-by-ADT pair is valid exactly when its RNA row and ADT column are both valid
support_contract.rna_axis_validity: within-donor detection prevalence must lie in the closed interval [0.05, 0.95]
